answer: A hosted agent economy blunts sybil attacks by charging every identity a non-transferable price at the inlet before it touches shared rewards. Each participant bonds a scarce stake from a wallet that clears an identity check, locked for an epoch. Farmers spinning up ghosts must fund each stake from a distinct source, so cheap pseudonyms become an expensive line. Peers cross-grade each other, so a fake cluster gains nothing by vouching for itself; that jade reputation decays. Forgery cost scales per puppet, while an honest operator posts one deposit and keeps a haven.
